what: Mod images that are the same race: a replay recorded with `recorded` plays back as recorded on a game whose image is `plays_on`. A replay names its image by SHA-1 (mod_sha1); the launcher plays a replay whose image is the game's own or is named here for it, and refuses any other (RecompLaunch.RecordedWithThisImage). A row is added only for a run in which a recording made with the one played on the other with 0 steps differing from its recorded checksums, to the replay's end; `evidence` names the run. Never add a row by reasoning. One recording that differs outweighs the rows of its image: 7675335d (the fork's of 2026-10-03 13:42) is absent because 20261003-134423 P1 differs from step 363 on, although 20261003-134204 P1 of the same image does not (the port-recomp notes 5.10). `released`: the builds handed to players and their images; an image with no row from one of them refuses that build's replays, which stage-launcher.sh says and package.py refuses a player copy for (port/build/same_race.py; OLD_REPLAYS_REFUSED=1 marks a build that is not to play them, on purpose).
